scope: Proposition 3.2 of the manuscript “Cyclic length and chromatic fixed-point loss” (preprints/Cyclic-Length-and-Chromatic-Fixed-Point-Loss-September-24-2026/Cyclic-Length-and-Chromatic-Fixed-Point-Loss-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 314 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1bf9f0b94473b85c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every occurring finite group is a p-group. The class of occurring groups is closed under subgroups and quotients. If A is any section of an occurring group, its minimum number of generators satisfies d(A) ≤ l.
